report: Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femoral tibyal kompartmanda en belirgin ve tam kata ulaşan eklem kıkırdağı kaybı ve dejenerasyonu, subkondral medüller fibrokistik ve fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve marjinal osteofitlerle karakterize. Medial menisküs ön köke yakın komşuluğundaki serbest cisim 5 mm çapında. Arka çapraz bağ ile eklem kapsülü arasındaki serbest cisim 5 mm çapında. Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs gövdesi düzeyindeki dejenerasyona alt eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen ve serbest kenarında defektin eşlik ettiği horizontal oblik yırtık eşlik ediyor. Medyale 7 mm ekstrude medyal menisküsün arka boynuzundaki üst ve alt eklem yüzeyi düzensizliği süperiyor ve inferiyor eklem yüzeylerine ulaşan kompleks dejeneratif yırtığı telkin ediyor. Arka çapraz bağın tibyal insersiyonundaki intraoseöz 5 mm çaplı gangliyon kistini hafif ödem çevreliyor. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 6 months of atraumatic knee pain, no prior surgeries
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Tricompartmental marginal osteophytes.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Areas of high-grade partial thickness cartilage loss in the central weightbearing aspect of the medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness chondrosis in the central weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness cartilage loss in the lateral patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral marrow edema. Additional high-grade partial thickness loss across the medial patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt and translation. Patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Tricompartmental osteoarthritis most prominent in the patellofemoral compartment.

2. Chronic superolateral patellofemoral maltracking.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Tendinitis de parte de la rótula.
Hallazgos:
Médula ósea de intensidad de señal conservada.
Meniscos medial y lateral de morfología y señal adecuados. Muy sutil irregularidad y edema de la unión
meniscocapsular posteromedial del menisco medial.
Se asocia a leve bursitis del semimembranoso adyacente. Discreto aumento de señal del tendón
semimembranoso, a nivel de la interlínea articular.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos, de aspecto habitual.
El cartílago rotuliano es discretamente heterogéneo en torno al vértice, con mínima irregularidad superficial
en la faceta lateral adyacente al vértice.
Cartílagos articulares troclear y de los compartimentos femorotibiales de espesor adecuado y superficie
regular.
No hay derrame articular ni sinovitis, ni tampoco distensión del receso gastrocnemio medial -
Semimembranoso.
Mínimo aumento de señal de fibras profundas y proximales del tendón rotuliano, adyacente al polo inferior
de la rótula.
Tendones cuadricipital, isquiotibiales y banda iliotibial de aspecto habitual.
Edema entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral, que sugiere fricción regional.
Estructuras musculares de señal conservada.
Impresión:
Leve condropatía rotuliana superficial.
Sutil edema del meniscocapsular posterior del menisco medial, inespecífico, podría representar pequeña
lesión regional.
Leve bursitis del semimembranoso, con mínimos signos de tendinopatía.
Signos de fenómeno de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
Mínima tendinopatía rotuliana proximal

Vidljiv manji koštani edem medijalnog kondila femura i medijalnog platoa tibije. Preostale koštane

siginala, degenerativne promjene straznjeg roga sa suspektnom rupturom.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Segment lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta koji se hvata na lateralni menisk izmijenjenog
intenziteta signala, moguće u smislu parcijalne rutpure. Medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog
signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Hondromalacija 1°patelarne
hrskavice.

Findings:  Small knee joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Minor edema superficial to the distal half of the MCL in keeping with a low-grade sprain. Intact cruciate and lateral collateral ligament.  Undersurface horizontal tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with an associated 11 mm x 8 mm x 11 mm parameniscal cyst at the level of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Intact lateral meniscus.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  Focal high-grade chondral thinning in the posterior aspect of the lateral tibial plateau. Otherwise relatively well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Undersurface horizontal tear of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with an associated 11 mm x 8 mm x 11 mm parameniscal cyst at the level of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Minor edema superficial to the distal half of the MCL in keeping with a low-grade sprain. Ancillary findings described above.

Menisküste volüm kaybı, posterior horn ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamande periligamantöz ödem izlenmiştir.Distal kuadriseps normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patella medial fasette kartilajda fokal bütünlük kaybı izlenmiştir.Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda bütünlük kayıpları izlenmiştir.Tibia interkondiler eminens anterior posterior hornunda çapraz bağlar yapışma düzeyinde subkortikal milimetrik kistler izlenmiştir.Suprapatellar bursada hafif sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Medial menisküste medial ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı ve grade III meniskopati. Lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati. Medial kollateral ligamande grade I sprain. Suprapatellar hafif bursit. Tibia interkondiler eminenste dejeneratif kistler.

Interprétation : 

Il y a une minime quantité de liquide au récessus suprapatellaire qui pourrait être de nature physiologique ou en lien avec un minime épanchement intra-articulaire. Il n'y a pas de kyste de Baker. 

Le ménisque interne de même que le ligament collatéral interne sont intacts et sans déchirure. Il y a une minime atténuation des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémorotibial interne, sans atteinte transfixiante ni changement sous-chondral réactionnel. 

Le ménisque externe de même que le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe sont intacts et sans déchirure. Le compartiment fémorotibial externe est préservé, sans atteinte transfixiante ni changement sous-chondral réactionnel.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts et sans déchirure. 

L’alignement patellofémoral est dans les limites de la normale. 

Il y a une légère tendinose du tendon du quadriceps distal et du tendon patellaire avec un épaississement, sans déchirure associée notée. Il n'y a pas de bursite. 

Il y a une chondropathie patellofémorale diffuse légère à modérée avec une atténuation des surfaces chondrales, principalement trochléaire et une atteinte plus marquée, modérée, à la jonction de la facette patellaire interne et de l’apex patellaire avec fissures chondrales quasi transfixiantes/de haut grade. De plus, le long de la facette patellaire interne inférieur, il y a un foyer de chondropathie focale sévère avec fissures chondrales transfixiantes et changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. 

Par ailleurs, il y a un kyste ganglionnaire multilobulé en lien avec le tendon poplité, probablement en communication avec sa portion intra-articulaire au versant postérieurm, mesurant environ 1,4 x 1,3 x 2,3 cm. 

Conclusion :

Il n'y a pas de dérangement interne (déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire significative). 

Il n'y a pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire significatif.

Il y a une minime chondropathie fémorotibiale interne diffuse.

Il y a une chondropathie patellofémorale, légère à modérée diffuse avec foyers focaux de chondropathie modérée à sévère tel que décrit ci-haut.

Il y a une légère tendinose des tendons du quadriceps distal et patellaire. 

Il y a un kyste ganglionnaire multiloculé au versant postérieur du genou.

Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage fissuring spanning the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle. High-grade cartilage fissuring along the posterior lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage fissuring along the central trochlea. Mild cartilage thinning along the medial patellar facet with mild subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:

Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.

No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Subchondral insufficiency fracture at the medial margin of the medial tibial plateau without articular surface collapse.

4.	Small knee effusion.
5.	Mild patellar tendinosis without tear.
